name: Miono Shizuku
source: 2nd lieutenant of the 1st Tactical Armor Regiment in the Imperial Japanese Army/Mainland Defense Force. Serves under Tatsunami Hibiki in the Wardog squad. Extremely close with Ellen Aice.
